# Correlations
## Import Libraries
```{r Import Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(Hmisc)
source("Code/Functions/CorrelationFunction.R")
options(scipen = 999)
```

## Import Data
```{r import data}
# use 03-OceanWaterQualityData-QCCutoff.csv
df <- read_csv("Data/Clean/YSI/02_QualityControl/02-YSI-Data-QCCutoff.csv")

```

## Create Correlation Matrix
```{r correlation matrix}
df_cor <- df %>%
  # take out columns that will give NA values in correlations (not enough observations)
  select(-date, -time, -chlorophyll_ugL, 
         -total_algae_cellsL, -total_dissolved_solids_mgL) %>%
  rename(`Chlorophyll (RFU)` = chlorophyll_rfu,
         `Conductivity (µS/cm)` = conductivity_uScm,
         `Dissolved Oxygen, Local (%)` = do_local_percent,
         `Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)` = do_mgL,
         `Dissolved Oxygen, Saturated (%)` = do_saturated_percent,
         `Conductivity, Non-Linear Function (µS/cm)` = nlf_conductivity_uScm,
         `Oxygen Reduction Potential (mV)` = orp_mV,
         `pH (mV)` = pH_mV,
         `Salinity (PSU)` = salinity_psu,
         `Conductivity, Specific (µS/cm)` = sp_conductivity_uScm,
         `Temperature (ºC)` = temp_c,
         `Temperature (ºF)` = temp_f,
         `Total Algae (RFU)` = total_algae_rfu)


```

## Get Significant Statistics
```{r }
# create nested list of matrices: p-values, n, r values
cor_mat_stats <- rcorr(as.matrix(df_cor))

# full flattened correlation matrix
cor_mat_stats_flat <- flattenCorrMatrix(cor_mat_stats$r, cor_mat_stats$P) %>%
  mutate(across(3:4, ~ round(.x, 2))) 
write_csv(cor_mat_stats_flat, 
          file = "Data/Clean/YSI/04_Correlations/01-YSI-Correlations.csv")

# flattened correlation matrix with only p-values <= 0.05
cor_mat_stats_flat_sig <- cor_mat_stats_flat %>%
  filter(p_value <= 0.05)
write_csv(cor_mat_stats_flat_sig, 
          file = "Data/Clean/YSI/04_Correlations/02-YSI-Correlations-Significant.csv")
  
```
